geeklist.title: THANKS for GIVING these games a new home Auction!
geeklist.description:
[b]Auction Rules[/b]
Good games looking for loving homes for the holidays! Looking to potentially shrink the collection a bit, while also freeing up some funds for Christmas. Some games I got without realizing they didn't work at 2 player, and some have just been on my shelf of shame for too long and would like to give someone with more passion to play them the ability to..... put them on their shelf of shame 😜.
Reminder: All sales will go through the BGG Marketplace so BGG can get their 3% of the sale.
[b]Auction will end Sunday November 23rd 2025, sometime between 7-9pm EST time to prevent sniping. If somehow I have not listed this as CLOSED by then, bids after 9pm EST will not be considered.[/b]
[b] 1 BIDDING: [/b] * All games will be listed with a minimum bid. Bids under the minimum will generally not be considered. Please use the comments at the bottom of the list for questions or discussion, and reply to individual items only to place bids. * Any item without bids may have its minimum and BIN prices changed at any time. * Please bid in increments of $1 or more. * I will try and list games with competitive prices
[b] 2 BUY-IT-NOW: [/b] * A bid at the [b]BIN[/b] level automatically closes the auction for that item. It will also mark you as a person of decision! * Cash or trade offers through other venues may also be accepted as a BIN during the auction.
[b]3 GAME CONDITION: [/b] * I will do my very best to give an accurate description of the game condition. I take good care of my games, but some I may have gotten through trade, so if there are flaws I will list any damage that is noticeable to me. Unless the game is described as "like new" or better, do expect some minor wear on the boxes and rulebooks. I often discard inserts in favor of bags or plastic container boxes for organization, but will list if have done so as well on each item.
[b]4 AUCTION END: [/b] * Auction will close at a time within the window specified. I will update the list header and call out auction winners for each item at this time. Please consider the auction closed automatically at the end of the closing window if I fail to update the list.
[b] 5 SHIPPING: [/b] * Shipping charge will be [b]actual USPS or UPS cost[/b] from 01562 USA (central Massachusetts) and will be paid by the winner. I will work to find the least expensive option (including USPS Regional Rate boxes) for each package. I don't like paying for shipping either, and I don't want you to pay any more than absolutely necessary. Due to the pandemic though, regional rate boxes may be limited or non existent, so please assume typical shipping options i.e. flat rate, priority, or first class. * I would be happy to do [b]local pick-ups[/b] in the Worcester, Massachusetts areas, but please keep in mind I will not go out of my way to meet. I do often get out to Boston and areas surrounding, so it's possible something can be worked out as long as it's during the work week. * I will also be happy to [b]combine shipping[/b] if you win multiple items!
[b] 6 PAYMENT: [/b] * All transactions will be done through the BGG marketplace so BGG will get its 3% commission. * Paypal, Amazon Gift Card or money order payment is fine (or even a check if you are willing to wait 2 weeks for it to clear). I can also accept cash for a local pickup. *Payment [b]must be made within 3 days of auction end[/b] or else you forego your right to the item(s).
*****FOR THOSE WHO BIN MULTIPLE ITEMS I WILL GIVE A 5% DISCOUNT OFF OF EVERYTHING YOU WON.******
Thanks so much for anyone reading and participating! I want to also thank DRasher seeing I copied most of his auction notes. :)
%SHIPSFROM% USA 01562 %SHIPSTO% United States ONLY %AUCTIONEND% Sunday November 23rd 2025, 7-9pm EST
